issues.title: Flatpickr internally using local computer timezone
issues.body:
The date displayed by flatpickr doesn't match that stored in the database, or displayed on the page.

Flatpickr can't handle timezones - and just uses the local computer one.

This means the dates shown by flatpickr are an hour out (daylight savings time)

It's not something the maintainers want to fix.
https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr/issues/1532

See the differences in the start/end time in the row header, and the start/end time in the form itself:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/221007394-eb79e972-28b8-4709-b0f8-81cd870fa652.png)

We can minimise this error by displaying ISO timestamps in the form.  The `hours` value in the popup form will still be wrong :-(
